name: Dock Fore
description: Dock Fore is a cozy, friendly bar known for its great prices, lively atmosphere, and excellent Jell-O shots. It offers a fun and relaxed environment where patrons can enjoy a variety of drinks, including happy hour specials and signature cocktails like frozen Irish coffees. The venue is appreciated for its attentive staff, local vibe, and community feel, making it a popular spot for both locals and visitors seeking a casual, enjoyable night out with occasional karaoke or open-mic events. Its intimate setting and welcoming environment stand out, although it doesn't operate as a full-time karaoke venue but hosts special events periodically.
